business.theme: apps.allnew.work landing page auto-sync with the public App Store
business.model: Every AllNew app that reaches READY_FOR_SALE appears on the landing page automatically; the page is the storefront that converts App Store presence into user acquisition without manual ops.
business.north_star_metric: parity gap = publicly released apps missing from the landing page (target: 0, detected within 6h)
business.operating_cadence: per-trigger (ASC webhook) + scheduled safety-net reconcile every 6 hours
constraints: Ground truth is the public iTunes Lookup artist listing (id=1875164184), never internal state or self-reported events
Existing catalog entries are never mutated by automation; discovery only ADDS
Per-app support/legal pages are out of scope; only landing data + index.html are written
No credentials required anywhere in the loop (works in GitHub Actions with the default token)
Content ownership: auto_onboarded entries converge on store content automatically; curated entries are never auto-edited (drift is surfaced as warnings only)

phases.name: Observe (store discovery)
phases.purpose: Fetch the full public app list for the AllNew artist from the App Store so that unknown releases are structurally impossible to miss, auto-onboard them into the catalog, and converge machine-owned entries with the published store content (curated entries only get drift warnings).

deliverables.name: Synced app catalog
quality_criteria: Every publicly released app id has a catalog entry
New entries carry auto_onboarded=true and slug_resolution provenance
Existing entries are byte-identical after sync (adds only)

deliverables.name: Content observations
quality_criteria: Tracks last-seen store name and icon artwork URL per app
Curated-entry drift (rename, icon change) recorded as warnings, never auto-applied
Baseline sightings produce no false warnings

phases.name: Reconcile landing data
phases.purpose: Refresh data/landing-apps.generated.json for every catalog app from the public App Store Lookup so status, URLs and release dates reflect reality.

deliverables.name: Generated landing data
quality_criteria: Every publicly released catalog app has status=released with app_store_url
Release dates come from currentVersionReleaseDate / releaseDate
Idempotent: unchanged inputs produce a byte-identical file

phases.name: Render landing page
phases.purpose: Bake the generated data into index.html (cards, JSON-LD, footer) deterministically so the deployed page equals the data even without runtime JS.

deliverables.name: Rendered landing page
quality_criteria: JSON-LD ItemList parses and numberOfItems equals released app count

phases.name: Verify parity (fail-closed)
phases.purpose: Prove that every publicly released app is on the landing page before the run may succeed; a gap turns CI red and opens the ANDON issue instead of being silently skipped.

deliverables.name: Parity report
quality_criteria: Records verdict, missing apps, exclusions, stale entries and enrichment backlog
Written on every run including failures
Timestamp churn suppressed when semantically unchanged

phases.name: Verify production (live readback)
phases.purpose: Prove the DEPLOYED page — not the repository — matches both the repo artifacts and the public App Store, and self-heal stale deployments by redeploying committed main once before blocking.

deliverables.name: Production readback result
deliverables.path: ci:landing-auto-update/live-verify (run logs + ANDON issue on failure)
quality_criteria: Live landing-apps.generated.json byte-equivalent (canonical JSON) to the repo file
Every non-excluded public app released in the LIVE data
Live index.html contains a card link per released app and a matching JSON-LD ItemList count

external_signal.detail: GET https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=1875164184&entity=software (jp+us) returns >0 software results; zero results or network failure after 3 retries aborts the run

precision_plan.false_positive_review: Apple Lookup outages show up as red runs with 'zero public apps'; reviewed via Actions history, bridged with the time-boxed circuit breaker if confirmed

external_signal.detail: update_landing_data.py --reconcile-app-store raises when App Store Lookup returns no results for known app ids (exit code observed by CI)

precision_plan.false_positive_review: Red run inspection; lookup flakiness distinguished from real delisting by the next scheduled run

external_signal.detail: render_landing_page.py re-parses its own output: all JSON-LD blocks parse, ItemList count and work-card count match released apps; SystemExit on mismatch

precision_plan.false_positive_review: A false block means anchors/JSON-LD drifted in index.html; caught in PR review of template changes and covered by pytest

gates.name: Public apps subset of landing page

external_signal.detail: landing_parity_gate.py compares the artist lookup listing against data/landing-apps.generated.json; any non-excluded public app missing/not-released/without store URL exits 1 (CI red + ANDON issue)

precision_plan.false_positive_review: False blocks are recorded as reasoned exclusions in config/parity_exclusions.json (audited list); state/parity_report.json keeps the last verdict and circuit-breaker use

gates.name: Deployed page matches repo and store

external_signal.detail: landing_live_verify.py fetches https://apps.allnew.work (JSON + HTML) with retries and compares against the repo artifacts and the artist lookup; any residual mismatch after one self-heal redeploy exits 1 (CI red + ANDON issue)

precision_plan.false_positive_review: CDN-propagation false blocks are absorbed by retry/backoff and one audited self-heal redeploy; residual false positives are bridged with the time-boxed circuit breaker and reviewed in the ANDON issue

qms_artifacts: GitHub issue label landing-parity-andon (open issue = ANDON open)

open_on: parity_gate block (missing public app on landing page)
live_readback block (production drift after self-heal redeploy)

kaizen.learning_routing: Every miss class becomes a structural guard: catalog-gated discovery miss (2026-07 basalsnap/meishibridge) became artist-lookup discovery + the fail-closed parity gate with pytest regression coverage in landing-automation/tests

L1.description: Propose only: automation produces diffs, human merges
graduation_criteria: 10 consecutive green runs with zero manual corrections

L2.description: Auto-commit data updates, human approves onboarding of new apps
graduation_criteria: 3 auto-onboarded apps published with correct slug/category without correction

L3.description: Fully autonomous publish; humans pulled in only via ANDON issue or enrichment backlog
graduation_criteria: Parity gap detected and self-healed within one scheduled cycle
False-positive rate of the parity gate below 1 per 30 days
